title: How to Reserve a Spot for an Event
content:
If a user asks how to reserve an event:

- Guide them to the CultPass app
- Instruct them to browse the experience catalog and tap 'Reserve'
- If it's a premium or limited event, check if reservation confirmation is required via email
- Remind them to arrive at least 15 minutes early with their QR code visible

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can reserve an experience by opening the CultPass app, selecting your desired event, and tapping 'Reserve'. Be sure to arrive 15 minutes early with your QR code ready."
tags: reservation, events, booking, attendance

title: What's Included in a CultPass Subscription
content:
Each user is entitled to 4 cultural experiences per month, which may include:
- Art exhibitions
- Museum entries
- Music concerts
- Film screenings and more

Some premium experiences may require an additional fee (visible in the app).

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Your CultPass subscription includes 4 curated experiences each month. You can choose from museums, concerts, film events and more. Premium events may have an extra cost, which is shown during reservation."
tags: subscription, benefits, pricing, access

title: How to Cancel or Pause a Subscription
content:
Users can manage their subscription via the app > 'My Account' > 'Manage Plan'.

- Cancel: Effective at the end of the billing cycle
- Pause: Preserves user data, resumes automatically when reactivated
- Do NOT offer refunds unless approved by support lead

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can cancel or pause your subscription at any time via the 'My Account' section in the CultPass app. Cancelation takes effect at the end of your billing cycle."
tags: cancelation, pause, subscription, billing

title: How to Handle Login Issues?
content:
Most login issues are resolved with password reset:

- Ask the user to tap 'Forgot Password' on the login screen
- Ensure they are using the correct registered email
- If they did not receive the reset email, check spam folder or retry after 10 minutes
- For persistent login issues, escalate to human support

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Try tapping 'Forgot Password' on the login screen. Make sure you're using the email associated with your account. If the email doesn't arrive, check spam or try again in a few minutes."
tags: login, password, access, escalation

title: Troubleshoot a Blank or Stuck CultPass App
content: Ask whether the app shows a blank screen or stays on the loading screen. Confirm that other apps can reach the internet, then close and reopen CultPass. Try an available Wi-Fi or mobile data connection and check the app store for an update. If the problem persists, collect the device model, operating system, app version, time of the failure, and any error shown. Route persistent failures to technical support.
tags: technical support, app loading, blank screen, connection

title: Troubleshoot CultPass Crashing After an Update
content: If CultPass closes unexpectedly, reopen it once and check for a newer app update. Restart the device and note the action immediately before the crash, such as opening the catalog or selecting an event. If the crash repeats, send technical support the app version, device and operating system, and steps that reproduce it. Before suggesting a reinstall, make sure the customer can sign in again.
tags: technical support, app crash, app update, device

title: Get Help When a Check-In QR Code Will Not Scan
content: Open the confirmed reservation in the CultPass app and display its QR code. If the code is visible, increase screen brightness and keep the full code on screen while the venue staff scans it. Check the reservation date and venue before attempting check-in again. If the code is missing or still cannot be scanned, ask venue staff or CultPass support for help. Share only the reservation reference through the support channel.
tags: technical support, qr code, check-in, scanner

title: Find a Missing Reservation Confirmation Email
content: Check the reservation in the CultPass app first. If it appears there, confirm its displayed status and check the inbox and spam folder for the email address associated with the account. Avoid placing a second booking while the first reservation is pending or confirmed. If the app shows no reservation or the message is still needed, ask support to investigate using the event name, reservation reference if available, and approximate time.
tags: technical support, confirmation email, email delivery, reservation

title: Get Help With a Blocked or Restricted Account
content: Keep guidance general until the customer's identity is verified. If the account lookup confirms a block, tell the customer that support will review the restriction and route the case to a human. Include the error shown and whether a password reset was already attempted. Avoid stating a reason for the restriction unless it was verified. Passwords and verification codes should stay with the customer.
tags: account management, blocked account, account access, identity

title: Update the Email Address on a CultPass Account
content: A signed-in customer can check My Account for an option to update their registered email and follow the verification steps shown in the app. If the option is missing or the customer has lost access to the old address, route the request to human support for identity verification. Use the official support channel to collect only the account information required for the change. The customer should keep passwords and one-time codes private.
tags: account management, registered email, email change, identity verification

title: Get Help With Duplicate CultPass Accounts
content: If subscriptions or reservations appear under different sign-ins, first ask the customer to check which account is currently active in the app. Discuss account-specific details only for the verified profile. Route requests to merge accounts or transfer a reservation or subscription to human support for review. Include the affected account references through the verified support channel.
tags: account management, duplicate account, sign-in, identity

title: Manage CultPass Communication Preferences
content: Check My Account for available communication settings and review the preferences shown for that profile. If the goal is to stop optional notifications, explain how to use the setting when it is available. Reservation or account notices may have separate controls. When settings are missing or messages continue after a saved change, ask support to review the message type and the most recent example.
tags: account management, communication preferences, notifications, privacy

title: Check Subscription Status and Monthly Quota
content: For general information, direct the customer to My Account and Manage Plan to see their plan details. To answer about a verified customer's subscription, use the subscription record for status, plan, and monthly quota. Monthly quota is the account's allowance, which differs from the number of experiences remaining after use. Avoid guessing account-specific values from a general plan article. If the record cannot be verified, route the question to support.
tags: billing, subscription status, monthly quota, plan

title: Review an Unexpected or Duplicate Charge
content: Ask the customer to compare the date, amount, and reference of the charge with the receipt or purchase shown in the app. If the payment provider marks one entry as pending, note both statuses for support before drawing a conclusion about whether there were two charges. Route unexplained charges to billing support. Use the approved support channel for references and leave full card numbers, passwords, and verification codes out of the ticket.
tags: billing, duplicate charge, pending payment, transaction

title: Troubleshoot a Declined Payment
content: Ask the customer to review the payment result shown in the app. If the transaction is marked pending or the status is unclear, check the purchase history before making another attempt. When the app confirms the payment was declined, the customer can review the selected payment method and details in the payment screen. Route repeated or unexplained declines to billing support with the time and non-sensitive parts of the error message.
tags: billing, payment declined, payment method, checkout

title: Request a Refund Review
content: Forward requests for a refund to human support for review. Collect the purchase reference, the relevant event or subscription, and a brief description of why the customer is requesting a refund. A support lead determines whether a refund can be approved. Until that review is complete, describe the request as pending and avoid promising an amount, outcome, or processing time.
tags: billing, refund, payment reversal, human escalation

title: Find the Details of an Existing Reservation
content: Open the reservation in the CultPass app and check its status, event date, start time, venue, and check-in instructions. Use the displayed confirmation or booking reference when asking about that reservation. If the reservation is missing or its details conflict with a confirmation message, ask support to verify the booking. Avoid treating a pending reservation as confirmed.
tags: reservations, reservation status, booking details, attendance

title: Check Availability for a Sold-Out Event
content: Ask the customer to check the event listing in the CultPass app for current availability and other displayed sessions. If there are no spots shown, the customer can look for a different date or similar experience in the catalog. Follow the options displayed for that event. Avoid promising that a place will open or that a waitlist is available.
tags: reservations, sold out, availability, limited capacity

title: Request a Reservation Change or Cancellation
content: Open the existing reservation and review the change or cancellation options and terms displayed for that event. If the option is available, check the new date and any displayed charges before confirming. If the option is missing, the booking is already in progress, or the terms are unclear, send the reservation reference and preferred change to human support. A request is pending until the app or support confirms the outcome.
tags: reservations, cancel reservation, reschedule, change booking

title: Review Premium Event Fees Before Reserving
content: Some premium experiences may have an additional fee. Check the event listing and review the amount displayed in the reservation flow before confirming. For questions about a specific charge, compare the receipt with the booking details and ask support to review any discrepancy. Use the price shown for that event and booking. Avoid quoting a general price for premium experiences.
tags: reservations, premium event, additional fee, pricing
